::: {#sol-count-pairs}

A pair is a choice of 2 of the 10 digits, where order does not matter:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\binom{10}{2}
&= \frac{10 \times 9}{2 \times 1}
&& \text{(choose 2 of 10, divided by the 2 orders of a pair)} \\
&= \frac{90}{2}
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&= 45
&& \text{(divide)}
\end{aligned}
$$

That is 45 [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) to design and test by hand,
and @sol-three-or-eight shows that some pairs need more than one.

:::
